rl.method: Q-learning, linear value function over 5 zone features, block-bootstrapped rain from this site's record
rl.assumption: moisture-stabilising a zone cuts its wetness swings by 50%; one zone per 12-day cycle, 5 cycles; exposure = cells x mm beyond 3 mm from today
rl.source: NASA NISAR GUNW (8 pairs, see out/provenance.json)
rl.reading: The learned policy does not beat the best simple rule (random order). The simple rule is enough here. Reported as found.

pinn.method: discrete-residual physics-informed network, numpy, 3-24-24-1 tanh; alpha, b, T trained jointly; tau from the grid fit
pinn.source: NASA NISAR GUNW (8 pairs, see out/provenance.json)
pinn.reading: On held-out passes the physics-informed network has lower error than the same network without physics.
